rows.text: stores `dl` at byte `+0x17E`, `dl+0x40` at `+0x17F`, the qword at `01F2CC98` indexed by `dl` at `+0xE8` and word `+0xD48` of row `dl` (stride 32) under qword `0209AC30` at `+0x17C` (`0x1000` becomes `0xFFFF`), clears bit 26, sets bit 27 and puts `r8b` in the low byte of dword `+0x180`; zeroes its count (bits 16-20) and accepts each 8-byte entry of the `+0xE8` table (count at dword `+0`) when `00252D10(word +4 + 9)` or `0057D610(byte +0x17F, word +6)` is non-zero, but skips word `+4` 5 when `r9d` is non-zero and needs `002CCA10(byte +0xD4B of 0209AC30)` non-zero for `0xA` and `0x1B`-`0x1E`, of which only `0x1B`, `0x1C`, `0x1D` or `0x1E` passes when that byte is 7, 8, 9 or 17; per accepted entry calls `00252D40(word +4 + 9, 1)` and fills the next 8-byte slot (`+0xF7` low byte of word `+4`, `+0xF6` index, `+0xF2`/`+0xF4` `0xFFFF`, `+0xF0` `002526F0(8, byte + 0x20, 1)`, 0 replaced by `0xFFFF`); then sets the next slot's `+0xF6` to `0xFF` and puts in bits 21-25 the first slot whose `+0xF7` equals `002526F0(8, byte +0x17E + 0x48, 1)` or, when byte `+0x17E` is 1 and `002CCA10` passes, `0x1B`-`0x1E` for 7, 8, 9, 17 and `0xA` otherwise (0 when none)
calls `002497E0(2, ecx*32)`, zero-fills `ecx*32` bytes of the returned block with `00861EC0(block, 0, ecx*32)` and returns the block

notes: 003FD360 (long row, near the 1,200 limit): the 5-bit count in bits 16-20 of +0x180 is read as signed (shl 0xB / sar 0x1B), so slot n is this + n*8 with n in -16..15; the row says 'the next slot' without stating that sign. In the final search the bits 21-25 were cleared beforehand, so 'none matches' leaves them 0. For a word +4 of 0xA or 0x1B-0x1E whose 002CCA10 gate passes and byte +0xD4B is not 7/8/9/17, the entry passes on edi alone.
